criteria.evidence: Recording clause: contracts/route-bundle-manifest.json defaults declare all six named dimensions (maxFirstLoadJsBytes 524288, maxCssBytes 65536, maxServerPayloadBytes 40960, maxImageBytes 524288, maxFontBytes 131072, maxThirdPartyBytes 102400, plus maxPageChunkBytes / maxScriptBytes / maxTotalBytes) and all 13 routes carry a measured value for each. But the record is wrong in two ways at head. (a) lazyLoadedModules is `[]` on 8 of 13 routes (/crm/inbox, /support/inbox, /calendar, /notifications, /settings, /build/my-work, /crm/leads, /parties) while those routes demonstrably have lazy boundaries - features/settings/settings-security-section.tsx:27,35 dynamic()-loads SettingsSecurity and MfaSettings, and features/calendar/calendar-view.tsx and features/calendar/event-detail-sheet.tsx both import next/dynamic. This is the exact mis-recording commit 31c3786a6 named ('lazyLoadedModules was recorded as [] while seven files under features/chat already used next/dynamic') and fixed for /chat only. (b) measurementNotes.provenanceSplit2026_09_03_ticket29 still asserts 'All 13 routes breach measuredScriptBytes' while the manifest's own data shows 8 of 13; and commit 31c3786a6 records that /chat's measuredScriptBytes 897,897 was NOT re-measured and 'knowingly OVERSTATES this route by roughly the 89,262 removed'. Budgets are also breached: check:route-bundle-budget exit 1, 9 breaches. Lazy-load clause is partly satisfied - charts (recharts, imported by 40 files), @tiptap editors, pdfjs, react-markdown and DOMPurify are split out - but by the manifest's own deferredSurfaces2026_09_04 note, chat's realtime SDK is 48,850 B encoded and 'cannot be deferred behind next/dynamic', Framer Motion is 41,196 B gzip 'on 461 of 462 built routes', and lib/query-keys.ts is 12,888 B gzip 'in every first load and is not tree-shakeable'.
criteria.blocker: The route-level record is inaccurate (lazyLoadedModules empty on 8 of 13 routes that do lazy-load; a stale note contradicting the manifest's own numbers; /chat's measuredScriptBytes knowingly overstating), and the recorded budgets are breached 9 times. Three shell-level surfaces required on first render are not deferred.
criteria.clauses_failing: accuracy of the recorded route-level budgets (8/13 lazyLoadedModules wrong, /chat measuredScriptBytes stale by design, self-contradicting measurementNote); lazy-loading of chat realtime media/SDK and the Framer Motion animation runtime; the recorded JS budgets themselves (9 breaches)
